mechanism_activity_probe.question: does the weight change the codes the quantization actually takes?

mechanism_activity_probe.verdict: the weight has geometric leverage: half the items take different codes

The old candidate guard used AF3 mu as a probability and used a different degree target from the round start.
Graph endpoints were compressed TRAIN-node indices, not catalog IDs.
The repaired support uses explicit train-degree-stratified quotas and deterministic tie handling; old support hashes and timings do not bind it.
The unapproved 150-second prefix truncation is removed; only a complete deterministic sweep can establish resource feasibility.
Real TRAIN cost, candidate eligibility counts, shared F0 calibration and active-phase four-rank admission must be rerun for the repaired source.
